name: Painting
dimensions: Height 115 cm; Width 58 cm; Height 146.5 cm; Width 74 cm
summary: This painting was probably once hung in a temple in China.  There is strong evidence to suggest that Sir Francis Henry May, Governor of Hong Kong 1913-1919, bought it to the UK. It is an example of 'foreign religions iconography' that interested the Christian clergy in the late 19th and early 20th c
